Wanted to start a discussion since it is an interesting change from earlier seasons :)
What are /v/leagueoflegends opinions on the changes during this season to jungle items and how they are increasingly used in lanes?

I personally think it is somewhat harmful to the overall game since it kinda breaks the role that champions were created for. While I think that it is great as a gimmick or something that promotes niche-picks, I also think that Riot are gonna need to rework jungle items to some extent to lessen the effect these jungle items have had in both the professional and casual scene on non jungle champions.

I like it for the variety it brings. Smite was created for jungle, but with all the posibilities it brings, i like that it's possible to use it in lane.

Mostly, i enjoy it because it brings some new possibilities to old kits. I'm mostly thinking runeglaive here, as it is really fun on AP nasus/AP GP. And since they don't seem to be OP, i have no problem with them being fun ways to play a champ, because they don't break top-level gameplay.

Do you think that is overall better for the game to have these possibilities or do you think that is more or less harmless? While I agree that it is fun with the variety it brings, I don't think it is overall helping the overall meta and I even think that it can be harmful to the game if Riot decides to nerf champions and not item which they often have before

If Riot can manage to balance the items, and not the champs, i think it's a nice addition with a few more viable paths for some champs.

My biggest concern is things like AP ez, which we saw completely out of control in LCS. And while teams found ways to beat it, i don't think it's healthy to have one champ be the entire focus, simply because it can become OP.

But i 100% agree, they need to adjust items, not champs.
